summary: A substantive finite-lattice dossier whose displayed proofs support its scoped observation-budget and penalty conclusions. No main-invalidating error was found after inspecting every rendered page and checking the major Cwikel input against its primary source. The result is rated 3.0/10 on the Millennium significance/quality scale, with 3 overall stars and minor revision for presentation. Classical mechanisms, uncertain priority, global rather than rectangular observations, the unresolved critical rectangular construction and no interacting/continuum bridge limit the significance. Exact backend identity and prior participation are unknown; manuscript historical context makes this nonblind. No independent full formal rebuild or archive replay was performed.
strengths: The actual unit-spacing Hodge normalization, real Fourier band and separate full-space/sector rank budgets are explicitly derived.
The regular-sector curve proof controls departure from the band through the quadratic form expansion and retains necessary regularity and penalty hypotheses.
Signed positive-total-coefficient envelopes support genuine compression traces and a finite integer-tail volume-density bound.
The global critical inverse-moment theorem and weak-box curls establish the sharp exponent within the specified scalar moment family.
Explicit profiles separate failed dyadic/threshold mechanisms from successful unrestricted rectangular partitions on the same profiles.
The prescribed-map penalty examples include all-field kernel premises, actual physical/coexact witnesses and an exact ambient optimum with a separately scoped coexact leading residue.
weaknesses: The unrestricted critical rectangular mean construction remains open; global spectral observations, the weaker D/4 bound and supplied-cube results do not resolve it.
No interacting Hessian identification, physical coefficient distribution proof, continuum limit or Yang-Mills mass gap is obtained; physical rescaling changes the finite thresholds.
Classical mechanisms account for most central tools, and an exhaustive priority comparison establishing originality of the specific synthesis is not_checked.

Independent Lean rebuilding, complete dependency/source-to-claim audit, reproduction-archive verification and rational replay are not_checked; manuscript execution claims remain reported evidence here.
The shared scalar coefficient theorem and full matrix-gradient theorem have different domains. Signed capped counts, actual selected-channel ranks and fixed-threshold counts must remain distinct.
Many constants and density bounds are nonoptimal. The exact scalar ambient penalty is not established as the complete restricted coexact optimum, although the leading residue transfers.

Operational history and historical assessments obscure the theorem structure. A compact theorem/hypothesis/verification map, supplemental workflow history and merged duplicate references would improve the paper.
